gen-dafont-arkhip-nunito-sans: Spaced-out geometric letters, a c as open as a bent paperclip, and no thick-and-thin swing: that's Arkhip. Arkhip announces; Nunito Sans, with its open-mouthed curves, quietly does the reading.
gen-dafont-azonix-fs-chillax: Authoritative in manner, Azonix keeps capitals barely above lowercase, so its words need a moment to knit back together. Chillax then loosens things, its spaghetti-like line and unfinished loops making extended reading feel casual and relaxed.
gen-dafont-azonix-fs-plein: Plein gives each round letter a clear channel in, reliable and clean, beneath Azonix, whose letters look drawn with a round-tipped pen. Azonix commands the top while Plein stays out of its way.
gen-dafont-azonix-fs-spline-sans: Wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp at small sizes give Azonix its commanding stance, with capitals barely taller than lowercase. Spline Sans keeps wide gaps between curve ends and stems, so paragraphs read in an approachable, contemporary way.
gen-dafont-azonix-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a stripe of constant ink, clean and dependable. Beneath commanding Azonix, the generous openings in every curve let whole paragraphs of text go down smoothly and steadily.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-almendra: Dignified and bookish, with a deep midsection in the lowercase, Almendra reads like a well-thumbed volume. Almendra gives the monoweight, commanding Azonix a warmer partner on the page.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-bree-serif: A constant-width pen line runs through every Azonix letter, giving the heading its commanding stance. But Bree Serif brings the refined, literary side, its outsized lowercase doing the quiet work of the text.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-port-lligat-slab: Azonix runs a single flat line weight through every glyph, and it earns its keep when big and brief. Port Lligat Slab brings porthole-wide counters and open-ended curves with room to breathe.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-quando: Rods, not carved blades: Azonix builds wide-mouthed, authoritative letters that stay crisp when shrunk, with capitals barely above lowercase. Quando wins on openness: sparse spacing and a big, tall middle zone.
gen-dafont-azonix-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans is modern and precise, a monoline construction with curve endings kept well apart, set beneath Azonix. Azonix commands the headline; Plus Jakarta Sans keeps the paragraphs tidy.
